purpose: Compose the already-qualified typed reference Richards solver service into the real B1.10 SoilWater task-2 transaction for the restricted admitted predicate, while preserving the unchanged direct HeadCalc route for unsupported states and preserving SoilWater task-3 bookkeeping ownership.

frozen_authorities.F_SI28: qualified optional same-factorization qbot tangent primitive
frozen_authorities.F_KT14: qualified accepted-only local-terminal sensitivity transport with stale-result exclusion
frozen_authorities.F_SI29_F_SI30: qualified restricted dynamic B1.10 top-boundary provider and solver adapter

forbidden: a duplicate outer transaction continuation state

restricted_route_predicate.constitutive: qualified B1.10 default MvG provider only
restricted_route_predicate.source_sink: qualified B1.10 source/sink provider; active root extraction not admitted
restricted_route_predicate.unsupported_rule: Select the unchanged direct legacy HeadCalc route before executing a typed solve. Never execute typed solver plus direct HeadCalc for the same hydraulic trial. Unsupported route publishes no typed sensitivity.

transaction_rules: Call SoilWaterStateVar(1) exactly once before either hydraulic route.
Only SW_SOLVE_CONVERGED may materialize the typed physical postimage.
SW_SOLVE_RETRY_ADVISED must enter the existing fldecdt/TimeControl(5) rollback-and-retry path and must publish no sensitivity.
A failed typed solve fails closed; it does not silently rerun the same trial through direct HeadCalc.
SoilWater task 3 remains the sole owner of accepted k/kmean/gwl/storage/flux bookkeeping and executes exactly once only after the hydraulic retry loop accepts.

For a physical interval containing multiple internal hydraulic steps, only the last accepted typed task-2 solve may supply the local-terminal interface sensitivity; unsupported/retried/failed later trials clear it.
Interface sensitivity remains result metadata and is never committed physical column state.
No second nonlinear Richards trajectory is permitted for interface sensitivity; the F-SI28 same-factorization one-backsolve route is the only admitted production path.
No MODFLOW sign conversion is introduced in this workunit.
diagnostics_rules: Typed solver diagnostics must be accumulated into the production worker diagnostics for every typed hydraulic solve in the physical trial.
Direct HeadCalc continues to update the production worker diagnostics itself.
Typed-route diagnostic forwarding must not double-count nonlinear iterations, Jacobian builds, linear solves, backtracking or alternative-solver calls.
required_executable_gates: admitted typed route versus direct HeadCalc physical postimage identity
dynamic top flux/head regime identity within the F-SI29/F-SI30 admitted profile
SoilWater task-3 exactly-once-on-accept and skipped-on-retry semantics
accepted local-terminal sensitivity reaches trial_outcome_t through the F-KT14 bridge
retry/unsupported/failed route cannot publish stale sensitivity
qbot mode 2 tangent adds exactly one backsolve and no additional nonlinear trajectory or Jacobian build
unsupported configuration remains direct HeadCalc route-equivalent
nonclaims: No whole-coupling-window derivative is qualified here; the result remains a local-terminal solve sensitivity.
No active root-extraction typed route is admitted.
No macropore, frost, swdra=2 surface-water coupling, time-dependent pondmx or nonlinear-runoff typed route is admitted.
No alternative-solver fallback reachability or frequency claim is added.
No change to C2B/Phi or RossFast normalization is permitted.
This workunit does not by itself close downstream F-ROSS01/J1E.
